security_audit_findings.description: Storage node epoch fencing blindly accepts any presented_epoch > current_epoch without requiring proof of cryptographic quorum election, allowing an attacker or partitioned node to artificially advance epoch and lockout legitimate leaders.
security_audit_findings.remediation: Require Ed25519 QuorumLeadershipCertificate containing >= 2 voter signatures before advancing node epoch watermark.

security_audit_findings.description: FencingToken contains only (epoch, leader_id, timestamp) in plain text without cryptographic binding to request parameters or payload SHA-256 digest, allowing replay or spoofing.
security_audit_findings.remediation: Introduce FencedOperationToken signed by certified leader covering (request_id, object_id, shard_id, version, payload_sha256, epoch).

security_audit_findings.description: WAL appends locally to disk but does not require majority acknowledgment before marking commit or advancing applied state, creating risk of metadata loss if primary crashes before standby replication.
security_audit_findings.remediation: Implement ReplicatedLogManager with Raft-style commit_index, log indices, terms, and majority quorum acknowledgment barrier.

security_audit_findings.description: Quorum votes are unauthenticated boolean responses without digital signatures, allowing spoofed vote grants across network.
security_audit_findings.remediation: Add Ed25519 QuorumVoteGrant signed by voter private key verifying epoch, candidate_id, and voter_id.
